book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Sambata Gishshas Shiiqida Oysho
Hessafe guye Yesusi Sambata gallas kaththa giddora aadhdhi bides. Iza kaallizaytikka gafida gishshas tiya duuththidi shigechchi muus oykkida.
Farsaaweti hessa be7idi Yesusa, «Hekko nena kaallizayti Sambata gallas oosettanaas bessonttayssa ooththeettes» gida.
Izikka isttas zaaridi, «Dawitinne izara diza asati gafida wode izi ay ooththidaakkon nababibeekketii?
Xoossa Keeththe gelidi qeesetappe attiin Dawitinne izara dizayti bochchanaas bessontta dummatida uketh mides.
Qasse qeeseti Sambata shaaridi Xoossa Keeththa giddon ooso ooththiko mooro gidonttayssa Muse wogappe nababibeekketii?
Gidikkoka ta inttes gizay Xoossa Keeththafe aadhdhizaadey haan dees.
‹Tani yarsho gidontta maaroteth dosays› giza qaalay ay guussako intte erizaakko xillota bolla pirdeketakkoshin.
Asa Nay Sambatas Goda» gides.
Heeppe izi aadhdhi bishe Ayhudata Woosa Keeth gelides.
Heenkka issi kushe silidaadey dees. Yesusa mootanaas gaaso koyidi, «Sambata gallas paththanaas bessizee?» giidi iza oychchides.
Izikka istta, «Inttefe issaade dorsi Sambata gallas ollan gelikko ba dorsaa izi gelidi ollaafe goochchi kessi erennee?
Histtiko asi dorsafe keehi aadhdhennee? Hessa gishshas Sambata gallas lo7o oosoy digettenna» gides.
Qasseka addeza, «Ne kushe piddisa!» gides; addezikka ba kushe piddisiin hinko kusheza mala paxa gidides.
Gido attiin Farsaaweti heeppe kezidi, Yesusa wostti oykki wodhanaakko ba giddon zorettida.
Xoossi Doorida Ashkaraa
Yesusi istta qofaa eridi heeppe haraso sher7i gides. Daro derey iza kaallides; harganchchatakka ubbaa paththides.
Izi oonakkonne asas yootontta mala istta azazides.
Hessika haniday nabe Isayaasan,

content.text: Ta Ayana ta iza bolla woththana;

content: Yesusanne Bi7elizeebula
Hessafe guye daydanththi oykkiin xeellanaassinne haasayanaas dandayontta issi as Yesusaakko ekki yida. Yesusikka iza paththiin addezi xeellanaassinne haasayanaas dandaydes.
Asay wurikka malalettidi, «Hayssi addezi Dawite naashaa?» gides.
Gido attiin Farsaaweti hessa siyidi, «Hayssi addezi daydanth kessizay daydanththa halaqa Bi7elizeebula wolqqan xalla gidanaas bessees» gida.
Yesusikka istta qofaa eridi, «Ba giddon issoy issaafe shaakettiza kawoteththi wurikka kundana; ba giddon shaakettiza katamay woykko keeththa asi minnenna.
Xala7ey Xala7e kessizaa gidikko Xala7ey ba giddon shaakettides guussa. Hessaththo hankko iza kawoteththi waani minnana dandayzee?
Tani Bi7elizeebula wolqqan kessizaa gidikko intte nayti aaza wolqqan kessanee? Hessa gishshas intte nayti intte bolla pirdana.
Gido attiin tani daydanth kessizay Xoossa Ayanan gidikko Xoossa Kawoteththi intteko yides guussa.
«Woykko issi asi wolqqara dizaade keeththe gelidi miishshe bonqqana koykko kasetidi he wolqqara diza addeza oykki qachchontta wostti bonqqanee? Qachchidaappe guye bonqqana dandayees.
«Tanara gidonttaadey tanara eqettees; tanara issife shiishshontta asi wurikka laallees.
Hessa gishshas ta inttes tumu gays; nagara oosoynne cashshi wuri asas atto geetettana shin Xillo Ayana cayidaadey maarettenna.
Ay asikka asa naa bolla haasayza iita qaalaa gishshas maarettanashin, Xillo Ayana bolla haasayza iita qaalay gidikko hayssa ha woden gidiin woykko buro yaana woden gidiin maaroy deenna.
Lo7o Miththi Lo7o Ayfen Erettees
«Miththi wuri ayfen erettizayssa mala intte lo7o ayfe demmanaas inttes lo7o miththi do; inttes iita miththi dizaa gidikko intte iita ayfe ekkana.
Intteno marzera diza shooshshatoo! Intte iitata gidi uttidi waani lo7o haasayanaas dandayeetii? Ulo giddon kumidaazi doonara haasayettees.
«Lo7o asi ba wozinan kunththi woththida lo7o qofaappe lo7o haasayees; iita asikka ba wozinan kunththi woththida iitateththaafe iita yo7o kessees.
Gido attiin ta inttes gizay asay ba haasayda hada qaala ubbaa gishshas pirda gallas wurikka oyshettana.
Gaasoykka ne qaalappe dendidayssan ne xillada attananne ne qaalappe dendidayssan ne bolla pirdettana» gides.
Malata Beyanaas Shiiqida Oysho
Hessafe guye issi issi Muse woga tamaarsizaytinne Farsaaweti Yesusa, «Astamaaree! Nu neeppe malalisiza malaata beyana koyoos» gida.
Izi isttas zaaridi, «Ha iitanne layma yeletay malata oychchees; gido attiin nabe Yoonaasa malataappe attiin hara malatay imettenna.
Yoonaasi gita mole ulo giddon heedzdzu qammanne heedzdzu gallas gam7ida mala Asa Naykka heedzdzu gallassinne heedzdzu qamma biitta garsan gam7ana.
Nannawe asay pirda gallas hayssa ha yeletaara dendidi ha yeletaa bolla pirdana; gaasoykka Nannawe asay Yoonaasa markkateththan maaroteth gelida gishshassa. Hekko Yoonaasappe aadhdhizaadey haan dees.

Dugeha dere kawoya Solomoone erateth siyanaas biitta gaxappe dendada yida gishshas pirda gallas iza hayssa ha yeletaara dendada ha yeletaa bolla pirdana. Hekko Solomooneppe aadhdhizaadey hayssan dees.
«Tuna ayanay asappe kezidi shempo demmanaas haaththi baynda mela biittan daaburees. Gido attiin ba koyza shemppoza demmenna.
Hessafe qasse kase ta dizaso simma baana giidi beniiso izi simmishin kase izi dizasoy aykkoyka baynda mela keeththe gididi geeyidayssanne giigetti dizayssa demmees.

Hessafe biidi hara baappe iitiza laappun iita ayanata banara ekkidi yees. Isttika he addezan gelidi de7ana. He addezas kase duussaafe guye duussay iita gidana. Hayssa iita yeletaska hessa mala hanana» gides.
Yesusa Aayeyonne Iza Ishata
Yesusi asaas yootishin iza aayeyanne ishati iza yoochchana koyidi karen eqqida.
Issi asi, «Hekko ne aayanne ne ishati nena haasayssanaas karen eqqidi nena koyeettes» gides.
Yesusikka, «Ta aaya oonee? Ta ishatich! Istti oonanttee?» gides.
Ba kushera bana kaallizaytakko malatidi, «Ta aayanne ta ishati haytantta.
Salon diza ta Aawa shene ooththizayti wurikka taas isha, michchonne aayo» gides.

footnotes.text: Issi issi geeshsha maxaafatan taybo oyddu tammanne laappuna bolla diza qaalay deenna.
